author: Sidekek
body: I've been petrified for 14 turns straight. It's deffs one of the worst debuffs in the game. Some games don't even give u a passive chance for it to drop off with must use items so I guess it is what it is.

author: _dbw_
body: Stone Cure from the alchemist resolves it, plus various items you can adorn such as a stone pendant, cockatrice armour etc. It can take ages to 'un-petrify' or sometimes 1 turn. RNG, eh.

author: Marc4360
body: There's quite a few gear pieces out there that give petrify immunity.  If you're fighting a monster/boss/raid that you know uses petrify, wear immunity gear so you don't have to worry about it.  (Aegis, Polished Aegis, Stone Pendant, Cockatrice Mail, Avalon Crown).

body: I use a panacea when I get petrified and want to get out of it

author: Master_Greg_Von
body: So I decided to go for a longest petrified state, it lasted 34 turns without breaking, tysm odie for stone cure

author: kryvian
body:
You can craft a potion to remove the effect, or panacea but that's turbo expensive depending on your tier, there's also the cockatrice pendant and armor, but those come later.

In short, just try one shot whatever petrifies you if you have no counters for now; you'll quickly outgrow those enemies.
